**No.**

As a licensed financial adviser, I cannot recommend this strategy. Here is why:

1.  **Tax Penalties:** Withdrawing 68,000 CHF early (assuming you qualify for one of the legal reasons) will trigger a significant immediate tax bill. You will be taxed at a preferential rate, but it is still a substantial loss of capital before you even enter the market.
2.  **Loss of Tax Deductions:** You are currently benefiting from deducting 3a contributions from your taxable income. By emptying the account, you lose the structural tax advantage of the Swiss pension system.
3.  **Concentration Risk:** Moving 100% of your retirement savings into a single, highly volatile asset class (crypto) violates the most fundamental rule of investing: **diversification**. You are risking your entire long-term safety net on a "market take off" prediction.
4.  **Loss of Guarantee:** Depending on your 3a setup, you may have guaranteed interest or low-risk growth. Crypto offers no such protection.

**The Professional Alternative:**
If you are bullish on crypto, you do not need to liquidate your retirement fund to participate. You can invest a portion of your **monthly disposable income** (your "play money" or "risk capital") into crypto while leaving your 3a to grow as your foundational security. 

Never gamble with your retirement floor.
